The gate additionally covers four heldout prompt suites alongside the four natural categories, and each scope is measured over 128 teacher-forced rows (the superseded binding used 4).

verdict.note: Every scope clears every binding term. State is bit-exact against the same-route reference in all eight scopes. The two top-1 flips are one each in code and general_en, the same two scopes that flipped in the two-scope screening run.
